# YouTube

> > YouTube is Google's comprehensive video platform ecosystem including the main streaming service, YouTube Music, YouTube TV, YouTube Studio for creators, and specialized programs for artists and researchers.

YouTube serves billions of users worldwide with video streaming, music services, live TV with NFL Sunday Ticket, and creator tools. The platform provides specialized resources through YouTube Studio, Official Artist Channels (OAC), the YouTube Researcher Program, and cultural trend analysis.

## Key Topics

- YouTube Studio
- YouTube Music
- YouTube TV
- NFL Sunday Ticket
- YouTube Shorts
- Official Artist Channel (OAC)
- YouTube Researcher Program
- Artist Analytics
- Content Creator Tools
- Music Promotion
- Live Streaming
- Channel Optimization
- Browser Compatibility
- 4K Plus
- DVR Features

## Core Platform

- [YouTube](https://youtube.com): YouTube homepage - main video streaming & sharing platform
- [YouTube Watch](https://youtube.com/watch): YouTube video watch page for streaming content
- [YouTube Mobile Watch](https://m.youtube.com/watch): Mobile YouTube watch page for video playback

## Premium Services

- [YouTube TV](https://tv.youtube.com/welcome): YouTube TV streaming service with 100+ channels, DVR & NFL Sunday Ticket

## Creator Tools

- [YouTube Studio](https://studio.youtube.com): YouTube Studio sign-in portal for creator content management
- [YouTube for Artists](https://artists.youtube.com): Music promotion platform featuring OAC, Collaborations & Artist Analytics
- [YouTube Studio Channel Appeal](https://studio.youtube.com/channel-appeal): YouTube Studio channel appeal sign-in page for creators

## Research & Insights

- [YouTube Research](https://research.youtube.com): YouTube Researcher Program providing data access & tools for academics
- [YouTube Culture & Trends](https://youtube.com/trends): YouTube trends, cultural analysis & 2025 global year-end report data

## Optional

- [YouTube Music Taste Profile](https://music.youtube.com/tasteprofile): YouTube Music tasteprofile page with browser compatibility warning
- [YouTube Music History](https://music.youtube.com/history): YouTube Music history page requiring browser upgrade
- [YouTube Music New Releases](https://music.youtube.com/new_releases): YouTube Music new releases page with deprecated browser message
- [YouTube Music Premium Family](https://music.youtube.com/youtube_premium/family): YouTube Premium family plan page with browser compatibility issue
- [YouTube Music Premium](https://music.youtube.com/music_premium): Music Premium subscription page requiring browser update
- [YouTube Music Explore](https://music.youtube.com/explore): YouTube Music explore page with deprecated browser notification
- [YouTube Live Stream Error](https://youtube.com/live/T8KdwZmS69s): Unavailable live stream error page with footer links
- [YouTube Footer Page](https://youtube.com/youtube।): YouTube footer page with Women's History Month promotional content
- [GuideRealm Channel](https://youtube.com/c/GuideRealmVideos): GuideRealm channel page offering tech tutorials and how-to guides
- [English Vocabulary Shorts](https://youtube.com/shorts/eOArLZif6iM): YouTube Shorts video teaching English idioms and prepositions
- [FAQ Meaning Shorts](https://youtube.com/shorts/N9kEYpK8q78): YouTube Shorts explaining FAQ meaning and helpfulness
- [SEO FAQ Shorts](https://m.youtube.com/shorts/F2herG5dD7A): Mobile Shorts video on FAQ SEO optimization for Google rankings
